title: phUSD mint authority is load-bearing for solvency: revocation, pause, or supply cap on IFlax bricks claim/stake/withdraw, stranding both phUSD principal and reward tokens

knownIssueCheck.candidate: KI-7 'PhlimboEA requires minting rights on phUSD token (configuration requirement, not bug)'
knownIssueCheck.rationale: KI-7 acknowledges that minting rights are a configuration requirement. This finding goes further: it identifies that the contract has no try/catch / fallback when mint reverts (revocation, pause, blacklist, supply cap), so a single external action GLOBALLY bricks the staker contract for any user with pending phUSD. The configuration-requirement framing is fundamentally different from the no-graceful-degradation defect. Sibling-contract revocation is a plausible operational event (not a 'reckless admin mistake' as the revocation may be sibling-side, not THIS owner). Kept and flagged.
